messages:
sarah-cs: flagging small account: AegisHealth pilot dropped from ~85% seat activity to ~30% overnight. noticed embed batch jobs paused. putting on renewal-watch.
ravi-am: thanks. any recent infra changes or prompts they changed? devon, did you touch enablement docs last week?
devon-csm: only minor prompt tweak. champion Dirk is OOO this week; procurement lead Marta is now driving. Marta said they're running a short comparative eval and paused heavy nightly jobs to save credits.
alice-eng: quick triage -> found a regression in the reranker model rollout (v3.0). some rerank ordering flips on test set.
alice-eng: repro snippet:
```
input: 10 candidate docs
expected order: [3,7,1,...]
v3.0 output: [7,3,1,...] // inconsistent with baseline v2.1
```
alice-eng: rolling a routing pin: route AegisHealth pilot traffic to model v2.1. canary started.
ops-bot: run-8921: routing-pin applied to 2 canary hosts. health checks running.
sarah-cs: i'll message Marta with context and offer a short QA call. devon can you prep a 10-min checklist (smoke tests + prompts) for Marta to run?
devon-csm: yes. will DM a tiny checklist: 5 prompts, expected ordering, embed token counts, timing.
marta-procurement: thanks for the quick update. we paused overnight runs because results were "noisy". if you confirm stability on v2.1 we'll resume. also procurement wants clarity on unit cost delta between v2.1 and v3.0.
ravi-am: noted. i'll draft a renewal note: propose 10% pilot credit for the month + free priority debugging if they commit to a paid rollout. hold until canary results.
ops-bot: canary health OK. rolling to remaining hosts (ETA 9m).
alice-eng: after pinning, rerank outputs align with baseline on our 25-case test set. latency unchanged. will put a blocking tag on v3.0 rollout until we run a model-eval.
sarah-cs: update sent to Marta. she asked for a short calendar slot to walk through the checklist. i'll set a time today.
marta-procurement: scheduled 30m in 2 hrs. also asked for a short note on fallback behavior if future rollouts change ordering.
devon-csm: adding fallback playbook: how to pin, where to find logs, contact on-call eng. will share in thread.
ravi-am: ok — if Marta still signals procurement risk after QA, escalate offer: 2-week credit + migration assistance. set reminder to revisit in 48h.
sarah-cs: agreed. thanks team. marking renewal-watch and pairing CSM + AM on the thread. :thumbsup:
